title: CLO 2026.0 - Optimized Texture Measurement
description: CLO 2026.0 version is now officially released — Make it, for real! The new version optimizes the texture custom measurement tool, allowing measurement lines to be directly locked onto texture outlines or panel edges. Additionally, measurement values can be dynamically managed in the property editor, making your designs more precise!
transcript:
In this Kolo 2026.0 update, we have optimized the Kolo 2026.0 with this new version and the improvements made after the update. The Kolo 2026.0 action line is also approved by the Kolo 2026.0. Kolo 2026.0 involves a short drive, allowing it to be processed in a very short time.

When you click the XML file button, you can access the Zip file, and a blank space will appear. After searching, you will find the Zip file located inside the Zip. Click the left mouse button to confirm the measurement point on the board. At this moment, the 2D window will display the measurement line in a virtual form. Please note that the data will be recorded immediately in the custom measurement section of the property editor.

You can rename the measurement line here, change its visibility, or delete it completely. At the bottom, there is an option to lock. You can choose to lock the outline line or the outline of the board. At this time, I need the measurement value to be locked on the outline of the board. After moving the sticker, you can see that the measurement line is locked at the HPS point. You can enter a specific data value below to accurately control the position of the sticker.

Next, we will try the second method. Lock the measurement line starting from the outline line outside the sticker. Also, after selecting the sticker, right-click and select custom measurement. This time, left-click directly on the outline line outside the sticker. You will see a purple line extending to the outline of the board. When you hover the mouse over the outline line, the length of the measurement will adjust. Left-click the outline line to set the measurement point. This purple line represents the measurement line from a certain point on the sticker to a certain point on the outline line. Both points are now set.

In the same way, you can rename and adjust the x-axis and y-axis position values in the attribute editor. Enter specific x-axis and y-axis values to obtain the exact position of the sticker. If you need to measure from a specific point inside the sticker instead of the outline line, you can use the Shift key shortcut. As before, enter custom measurement mode. Press the Shift key and click on any point in the image, for example, the end point or a specific detail point of the outline. These points will be automatically recognized.

Select the target point on the sticker. There is a certain subtraction function when selecting. This flexibility allows you to record measurement information from any position in the image. For example, I chose this recommended pivot point in the image, then measured the distance from the point to the side. You can also enter a specific value in the attribute editor for precise positioning of the sticker.

Finally, we updated the 3D window interface. Now you can quickly hide or display stickers. To check the basic principle of clothing, simply go to the menu bar and navigate to clothing display. Then open or close the display sticker. We hope this sticker measurement function update ensures that your sticker position is always accurate.

chunks.title: CLO 2026.0 - Optimized Texture Measurement
chunks.content: ## CLO 2026.0 Update Overview and Optimized Texture Measurement This section covers the improvements and new features introduced in CLO 2026.0, focusing on the optimized texture measurement process and enhanced interface functionalities related to sticker positioning and measurement. The CLO 2026.0 update includes optimizations that allow for faster processing due to a shortened drive time in the action line. The update ensures improved accuracy and usability in texture and sticker measurements within the software, providing users with enhanced control over measurement points and sticker positioning. --- ## Accessing and Managing Measurement Data This section explains how to access measurement files and manage measurement lines within CLO 2026.0, including file handling, measurement confirmation, and basic editing options. When clicking the XML file button, users can access a Zip file containing measurement data. After locating the Zip file, clicking with the left mouse button confirms the measurement point on the board. This action immediately records the data in the custom measurement section of the property editor. Within this section, users can rename measurement lines, toggle their visibility, or delete them entirely. A lock option is available at the bottom to lock either the outline line or the outline of the board itself. Locking the measurement line on the board's outline ensures that the measurement value remains fixed, even if the sticker is moved. Users can input specific data values to precisely control sticker positioning. --- ## Measurement Methods and Custom Measurement Mode This section details two measurement methods for defining measurement lines relative to stickers, including the use of mouse controls, line locking, and custom measurement mode with keyboard shortcuts. ### Method 1: Locking Measurement Line on Board Outline - Lock the measurement line starting from the outline line outside the sticker. - Select the sticker, right-click, and choose "custom measurement." - Left-click directly on the outline line outside the sticker. - A purple measurement line appears, extending to the board’s outline. - Hovering over the outline line adjusts the measurement length. - Left-click the outline line to set the measurement point. - Rename the measurement line and adjust x-axis and y-axis position values in the attribute editor for exact sticker placement. ### Method 2: Selecting Specific Points with Shift Key Shortcut - Enter custom measurement mode. - Hold the Shift key and click any point in the image, such as an endpoint or detailed outline point. - The software automatically recognizes these points. - Select the target point on the sticker. - A subtraction function allows flexibility in recording measurement information from any position in the image. - For example, measure the distance from a recommended pivot point to the side. - Enter specific x-axis and y-axis values in the attribute editor for precise control. --- ## 3D Window Interface Enhancements and Sticker Visibility Controls This section summarizes updates to the 3D window interface that improve the management of sticker visibility and display settings related to clothing principles. The 3D window interface now allows users to quickly hide or display stickers.
